calculation.description: Ten-day price reversal scaled by trailing 20-day annualized volatility, with a mild cross-sectional penalty for absolute rolling 60-day beta to DXY. All inputs are available through the prior completed day. Higher values indicate stronger reversal opportunity.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC in all examined regimes; 2020-2024 IC 0.06527/ICIR 0.19884, 2025-2027 0.00954/0.02815, 2028-2029 0.05122/0.13773, 2030-2032-10-03 0.03467/0.10090. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
